in_marathi.name: Jevisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jevisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jevisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jaya’ meaning victory and ‘isha’ meaning goddess. In Hindu mythology, Jevisha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is also known as ‘Sri Laxmi’ and ‘Saraswati’, the goddesses of wealth and knowledge respectively.

In Hindu mythology, Jevisha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is also known as ‘Sri Laxmi’ and ‘Saraswati’, the goddesses of wealth and knowledge respectively.
